SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kancha_diff (
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,

	result1  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result2  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  r1_q1  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	r2_q1  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  r1_q2  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	r2_q2  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	
  r1_q3  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	r2_q3  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  r1_q4  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	r2_q4  int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;


DELETE FROM s_kancha_diff  WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
/*ปีก่อน*/
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kancha_diff   (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,result1,r1_q1,r1_q2,r1_q3,r1_q4)
SELECT 
@id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,result2,r2_q1,r2_q2,r2_q3,r2_q4
FROM  s_kancha_diff  s INNER JOIN chospital h ON s.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode
WHERE s.b_year = 2564;

/*up ปีปัจจุบัน*/
UPDATE s_kancha_diff s INNER JOIN (
SELECT h.hoscode,(@b_year+543) as b_year

,COUNT(DISTINCT CID) as result2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CID,NULL)) as r2_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CID,NULL)) as r2_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CID,NULL)) as r2_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CID,NULL)) as r2_q4

FROM  tmp_drug_kancha t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode
WHERE t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
GROUP BY h.hoscode
) as t ON s.hospcode=t.hoscode 
SET s.result2=t.result2
,s.r2_q1=t.r2_q1
,s.r2_q2=t.r2_q2
,s.r2_q3=t.r2_q3
,s.r2_q4=t.r2_q4
WHERE s.b_year=t.b_year  ;

/*INSERT ปีปัจจุบัน*/
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kancha_diff  (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,result2,r2_q1,r2_q2,r2_q3,r2_q4)
SELECT @id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT CID) as result2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CID,NULL)) as r2_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CID,NULL)) as r2_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CID,NULL)) as r2_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CID,NULL)) as r2_q4
FROM  tmp_drug_kancha t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode
WHERE t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
GROUP BY h.hoscode;

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("result1") AS "result1", SUM("result2") AS "result2", SUM("r1_q1") AS "r1_q1", SUM("r2_q1") AS "r2_q1", SUM("r1_q2") AS "r1_q2", SUM("r2_q2") AS "r2_q2", SUM("r1_q3") AS "r1_q3", SUM("r2_q3") AS "r2_q3", SUM("r1_q4") AS "r1_q4", SUM("r2_q4") AS "r2_q4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT c.splevel as a_code ,c.splevel as a_name , SUM("result1") AS "result1", SUM("result2") AS "result2", SUM("r1_q1") AS "r1_q1", SUM("r2_q1") AS "r2_q1", SUM("r1_q2") AS "r1_q2", SUM("r2_q2") AS "r2_q2", SUM("r1_q3") AS "r1_q3", SUM("r2_q3") AS "r2_q3", SUM("r1_q4") AS "r1_q4", SUM("r2_q4") AS "r2_q4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON h.hoscode = c.hcode LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY c.splevel
